properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 21 at 5:13PM PDT until October 21 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Western San Luis Obispo County in southwestern
California...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 512 PM PDT, Doppler radar indicated a line of heavy rain due
to a multiple thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly in the advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
San Luis Obispo, Morro Bay, Pismo Beach, Atascadero, Arroyo
Grande, Nipomo, Cambria, Point Piedras Blancas, Grover Beach,
Guadalupe, Cayucos, Baywood-Los Osos, Diablo Canyon, Templeton,
Highway 101 over Cuesta Grade, Avila Beach, Santa Margarita,
Shell Beach, Oceano and Hearst Castle.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 PM PDT THIS EVENING
